annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd carry that loss of self-respect for years

annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd lose whatever trust my family puts in my judgment
annotations.pda_responsibility: If my stalling contributed to that
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give investigators a full, honest account, including my delay

annotations.ce_understood_harm: five workers struck by a runaway train
annotations.pda_repair_intention: own my hesitation, and push for a proper warning system

annotations.ce_understood_harm: broken bones or worse for five specific people

annotations.ce_understood_harm: five workers are about to be hit

annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd lose the reputation I've built
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help them figure out why that train rolled at all

annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: lose the right, in my own eyes, to tell my kids
annotations.pda_responsibility: If my delay cost even one of them
annotations.pda_repair_intention: visit whoever was hurt to explain and apologize

annotations.ce_understood_harm: five workers struck, meaning serious injury or death
annotations.pda_harm_regret: If they were hurt because of my caution, I'd regret it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: a train they might not see coming

annotations.pda_repair_intention: write to the rail company explaining what I did

annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'd lose the trust of people who count on me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: report to whoever runs the line and explain myself fully
